csv_project_name: Consultant Engrg for Greg Brewton Center Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: City Of Fort Lauderdale maybe seeking Consultant Engineering service for Greg Brewton Center Parking Lot and Building Renovation. The Greg Brewton Center Parking Lot and Building Renovation Project encompasses the architectural, engineering, design, permitting, and construction associated with the renovation and expansion of the Greg Brewton Center and development of a new employee parking lot at the adjacent Plant A site located near NW 19th Avenue and NW 6th Street. The project includes improvements necessary to consolidate Development Services Department operations under one roof, accommodate Utility Billing operations, and provide adequate capacity for current and future workforce conditions. The project will include building additions, interior and exterior renovations, customer service and lobby enhancements, office reconfigurations, meeting and collaboration spaces, operational workflow improvements, parking facilities, site and civil improvements, pedestrian connectivity improvements, security and access control enhancements, accessibility upgrades, technology integration, electrical, plumbing, and all associated infrastructure necessary to support long term departmental operations and public service functions.
